alt: The sample file rfc8259.md is split by RecursiveSplitter and embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2, and each chunk becomes a point in the Qdrant collection TextEmbedding with filename, chunk_start, chunk_end and text in its payload; editing one section upserts only that point, and the query "how is a JSON object written?" returns the chunk on JSON objects.

run.cmd: python main.py "how is a JSON object written?"
